input.label: feature
input.reply:
Thanks for the detailed feature request! You're asking for enhanced DOM visualization in the Vitest UI—specifically rendering prettyDOM with visual highlighting of matched elements when multiple are found.

This is a good UX improvement for debugging test failures, especially when elements lack unique identifiers. The proposed solution of rendering the full DOM with matched elements highlighted (e.g., with a background color) would make it much clearer which elements were selected.

This would likely involve changes to the UI reporter. Consider opening a discussion in Vitest's GitHub discussions or Discord to gauge community interest, or submit a PR if you're interested in implementing it.
